items.reason: The area's files make no server calls (no table read, no database function, no fetch): they are pure rules fed by the data layer. The rules they hold for the front desk are repeated on the server: a desk sale or payment at most 31 days back, at most 10% off, the joining fee for a new member, and no change to an existing plan (so a desk 'approve pause' cannot add days; the server's approve also needs the owner-written freeze mark). The one rule that is screen-only is the desk's 'never sees money totals': the desk's device is sent every receipt and expense (existing finding reused).

The area has no tables of its own; its features' data sits in tables with row security on, no policy and no direct app rights, read only through key-checked functions. Other-gym tests per table: gym records (members, plans, payments, PT packs, pass members, join-online enquiries) security.sql 6b/6c; workout plans 0024 8push; member photos 0043 test 7; plan requests 0044 5other and GONE; phone links 0048 2b; web push 0076 other key; bring-a-friend 0056 4othergym; workout offer 0025 test 10; job titles 0079 3othergym; page chat 0094 1other; join online 0077 3othergym and 8 (table shut); member messages 0069 4othergym; Plus lock 0070 3other; PT 0065 3othergym; MettleUp payments 0060 test 10; challenges 0037 6other and 8theirs; trainer members and progress 0050 6othergym.
Rule applied: every table behind this area's features has at least one test where another gym's key is refused or sees nothing; no new finding.
Rule applied: no live cross-gym attempt was run; only code, catalog and test files were read.
No key pattern hit in the area (machine scan) and no environment key, API key or secret in its files; the only key-like code turns the browser's public push key into bytes.
No paid or AI key lives in or is used by these files; the web-page chat file only sorts and labels saved chat lines.
No sign-in, session or PIN code in this area; the PIN appears only in update-note words. Sign-in is checked in panel/auth-data.

Typed text is guarded where it leaves the panel: a trainer's video link must be an https YouTube link (same rule as the server); the UPI ID must match a UPI pattern and the payee and note are cut to plain letters and encoded; the pass-visit download goes through the CSV writer's formula guard; a web-page sheet's tags are stripped with a pattern that cannot run slow. No HTML is built from member text here.

Desk photo: the panel refuses files over 25 MB or not a picture and shrinks to a small JPEG; the server only takes a real JPEG up to 100,000 bytes through a key-checked function, tested for size, type and other gym. Member-list import: the sheet is read inside the browser only and the panel's spreadsheet reader is the patched 0.20.3.

The new-gym card shows the gym's join code and join link, and that code can be found by trying codes (existing finding reused). The member card's QR holds only the member's random id, no name or phone.

The area's only outside libraries are the two spreadsheet readers. The panel's own SheetJS copy is 0.20.3, past both flagged advisories (fixed in 0.19.3 and 0.20.2); the npm audit alerts point at the root copy 0.18.5 used by the phone app, not the panel. read-excel-file has no alert.
